bootstrap_policy: Paired score differences are computed within each model/prompt triplet. Cross-model pooled confidence intervals use a cluster bootstrap over underlying (behavior, prompt_id) prompts so repeated evaluation of one prompt across models remains within the same resampled cluster.
generation_stability_policy: The 12 persistent nontermination events are reported separately. Their complete matched triplets were excluded from behavioral-content judging before the condition key was opened.
